name: Cancelled KOT's
query:
SELECT 
    b.`date` AS "Date",
    CONCAT(
    LPAD(IF(HOUR(b.`time`) > 12, HOUR(b.`time`) - 12, HOUR(b.`time`)), 2, '0'),
    ':',
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(b.`time`, ':', 2), ':', -1),
    CASE WHEN HOUR(b.`time`) >= 12 THEN ' PM' ELSE ' AM' END
    ) AS "Time",
    b.`name` AS "URY KOT:Link/URY KOT",
    b.`invoice` AS "Invoice:Link/POS Invoice",
    b.`original_kot` AS "Original KOT",
    b.`owner` AS "Cancelled By",
    pi.`cancel_reason` AS "Cancel Reason"
FROM 
    (
        SELECT %(start_date)s AS `date`
        UNION
        SELECT DATE_ADD(%(start_date)s, INTERVAL n DAY) AS `date`
        FROM (
            SELECT a.N + b.N * 10 + c.N * 100 + 1 AS n
            FROM (
                SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
            ) AS a
            CROSS JOIN (
                SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
            ) AS b
            CROSS JOIN (
                SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
            ) AS c
            ORDER BY n
        ) AS nums
        WHERE DATE_ADD(%(start_date)s, INTERVAL n DAY) < %(end_date)s
        UNION
        SELECT %(end_date)s AS `date`
    ) AS date_list
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY KOT` b ON (
        b.`branch` = %(branch)s
        AND b.`type` = 'Cancelled'
    )
    LEFT JOIN `tabPOS Invoice` pi ON b.`invoice` = pi.`name`
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
        rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    )
    WHERE
    (
        ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND b.`date` = date_list.`date`)
        OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(b.`date`, b.`time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(date_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(b.`date`, b.`time`) >= TIMESTAMP(date_list.`date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
        OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND b.`date` = date_list.`date`)
    )
GROUP BY 
    b.`invoice`
ORDER BY 
    date_list.`date` ASC, b.`name` ASC,b.`time` ASC
